description.en: When you want the lens that pairs most seamlessly with the body, first-party is always the safe bet. Fujifilm splits its glass into the higher-end XF and the lighter XC, with autofocus, color, and firmware tuned tightly to the camera. Because X-mount was built for APS-C from day one, these lenses match Fujifilm's own rendering closely.
description.zh: 想要和机身配合最顺的镜头，原厂总是稳妥的选择。富士原厂分高阶的 XF 与轻量的 XC 两条线，对焦、色彩、固件都和机身深度绑定；加上 X 卡口从一开始就为 APS-C 专门设计，成像风格也最贴合富士自家的取向。

shortDescription.en: XF and XC — first-party, through and through

description.en: One of the most prolific affordable third-party makers on X-mount. 7Artisans started with metal manual primes at modest prices, and its autofocus and cine lines have filled out fast. You get a mechanical focus feel and slightly vintage rendering at an easy price.
description.zh: 国产副厂里产品线很广的一家。七工匠以金属手动定焦起家，价格亲民，近年自动对焦线和电影头也在快速补全。特点是扎实的机械手感和偏复古的成像味道，适合看重拍照过程本身的用户。

shortDescription.en: Affordable metal manual primes and growing AF lines
shortDescription.zh: 平价金属手动头与逐步完善的自动线

description.en: Hard to skip if you're looking for third-party autofocus on Fuji. This page covers Viltrox's X-mount lineup, from the light Air series up to the F1.2 Pro primes — pairing bright apertures and sharp optics with focus motors that keep closing the gap with first-party glass.
description.zh: 看富士副厂自动对焦镜头时，唯卓仕通常绕不开。这里收录它的 X 卡口型号，从轻便的 Air 到 F1.2 的 Pro 都在其中——用相对克制的价格给到大光圈和不错的光学素质，对焦马达也一直在追近原厂。

shortDescription.en: Native AF lenses from light Air primes to F1.2 Pro
shortDescription.zh: 从轻量 Air 到 F1.2 Pro 的原生自动头

description.en: TTArtisan tends to build the niches other makers skip: F0.95 glass, tilt-shift, 2× macro, pancakes, and fisheyes — mostly manual focus in compact retro barrels at accessible prices, built for photographers looking for something offbeat.
description.zh: 别家不太愿意做的偏门规格，铭匠常常出：F0.95 夜神、移轴、2 倍微距、饼干头、鱼眼。以手动头为主，外观偏精致复古，价格不贵，适合喜欢尝鲜或追求特殊视角的人。

shortDescription.en: Retro barrels and offbeat manual optics
shortDescription.zh: 复古外观与丰富偏门规格

description.en: Sigma brought the optical engineering it built up in full frame over to Fuji with native autofocus tuned for X-mount. Its lenses are consistently sharp and solidly built, and the Contemporary line in particular packs high resolution into small APS-C barrels.
description.zh: 适马把全画幅时代积累的光学设计搬到了富士卡口，配上专门调校的原生自动对焦。普遍锐度扎实、做工规整，尤其 Contemporary 系列把不错的画质装进了小巧的体积里，常被拿来和原厂高阶型号对比。

shortDescription.en: Sigma's sharp APS-C optics, native to X-mount
shortDescription.zh: 高锐度、体积紧凑的原生 X 卡口镜头

description.en: Compact manual primes from Brightin Star, focused on small metal barrels and low entry prices across wide to standard focal lengths. An easy place to start if you want to try pure manual focus without spending much.
description.zh: 星曜的紧凑型手动定焦，主打小体积、金属镜身和亲民定价，焦段集中在广角到标准。如果想低成本试试纯手动对焦和机械阻尼手感，这是个不错的起点。

shortDescription.en: Compact manual primes at an easy entry price
shortDescription.zh: 紧凑型手动头，入门成本低

description.en: Manual-focus lenses with German design heritage, built in Japan by Cosina. Known for smooth all-metal focus helicoids, low distortion, and a balance of sharpness and classic character. On X-mount, electronic contacts pass EXIF, focus confirmation, and focal length for IBIS while focus and aperture remain mechanical.
description.zh: 带德系设计血统、由日本确善能（Cosina）制造的高阶手动对焦镜头。以全金属对焦螺旋的细腻手感、极低畸变和兼顾锐度与氛围的成像闻名；X 卡口版带有电子触点，可以向机身传递 EXIF、合焦提示和防抖焦距，同时保留纯机械对焦与光圈操作。

shortDescription.en: Precision manual optics with electronic contacts
shortDescription.zh: 精密全金属手动工艺，支持机身电子通讯

description.en: While most makers compete on brighter apertures and faster motors, Laowa competes on wider and closer. Zero-D low-distortion ultra-wides, probe macros, and shift zooms solve framing problems that standard lenses simply cannot.
description.zh: 大多数厂商卷大光圈和对焦速度，老蛙专门卷“更广”和“更近”。Zero-D 零畸变超广角、探针微距、移轴变焦——产品线里多是常规镜头拍不到的特殊视角。

shortDescription.en: Specialist glass for ultra-wide and extreme macro
shortDescription.zh: 专攻超广角与特种微距

description.en: A longtime Japanese zoom specialist, Tamron brings native X-mount zooms spanning fast constant-aperture models, telephotos, and all-in-one travel superzooms — most with VC optical stabilization in relatively compact barrels.
description.zh: 日系变焦老厂腾龙在富士 X 卡口的产品以原生变焦为主，涵盖恒定大光圈、长焦和大变倍旅行头，多数型号带 VC 光学防抖，体积控制相对紧凑，对焦和防抖能与机身直接联动。

shortDescription.zh: 带 VC 防抖的日系原生变焦

description.en: SG-Image covers a surprisingly wide mix on X-mount: slim pancakes, fisheyes, F0.95 primes, and shaped-aperture novelty lenses — mostly manual focus alongside a few autofocus pancakes, all at budget-friendly prices.
description.zh: 深光影像在 X 卡口的覆盖面挺广：薄饼干头、鱼眼、F0.95 大光圈和异形光圈创意头都有，以手动为主，也有少量自动对焦饼干头，定价亲民，适合想低成本玩点花样的用户。

shortDescription.en: From slim pancakes to F0.95 at budget prices
shortDescription.zh: 从饼干头到 F0.95 的平价新锐

description.en: Meike makes both stills and cinema glass, and on X-mount focuses on affordable autofocus primes across its Neo, Air, and Pro lines — from compact standards to portrait teles. Its cinema lenses are listed separately.
description.zh: 美科同时做照相和电影镜头，在 X 卡口这边主要布局平价自动对焦定焦，Neo、Air、Pro 几条线从小巧标头到人像中长焦都有覆盖。电影镜头不在本合集内。

description.en: Known first for affordable anamorphic cine lenses, Sirui has carried that optical work into autofocus stills primes on X-mount: the Sniper series offers F1.2 primes, while the Aurora series adds weather sealing at F1.4.
description.zh: 思锐早期在视频圈以平价变形宽银幕电影头出名，近几年把经验扩展到了照相自动对焦定焦。X 卡口上以自动定焦为主：Sniper 系列主打 F1.2 大光圈，Aurora 系列则是带防滴防尘的 F1.4 型号。

shortDescription.en: Autofocus primes built around F1.2 and F1.4
shortDescription.zh: 主打 F1.2 与 F1.4 的自动对焦定焦
